channel.title: Security on Naman Aggarwal
channel.description: Recent content in Security on Naman Aggarwal

item.title: Kerberos with FTP
item.description: We will setup a FTP server and use kerberos for authentication. We will use vsftpd as the FTP server and kerberos for authentication. We will use lftp to login to the FTP server and test the kerberos authentication.

item.title: Private Tor Network
item.description: We will setup a private tor network with 3 relays, 1 exit node, 1 client and 1 server. This will simulate a private tor network and we will see the network traffic between the client and the server with and without tor.

item.title: Tor Client Setup
item.description: We will setup a tor client and use it to create custom tor circuits. Further we can setup the browser to use tor client through socks proxy and use the custom tor circuit to browse the internet and fetch data.

item.title: Firewall Setup using PF
item.description: We will be creating a setup for a simple web application to be acessed via firewall that we will making using PF of FreeBSD.
